environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not block), and (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request URI query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|select[\s/\*]+(?:.*?from)|(?:benchmark|sleep|waitfor|pg_sleep)\s*\()` with action BLOCK, combined with a second rule in the same group using a SqliMatchStatement on QueryString with TextTransformation URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE with sensitivity level HIGH and action BLOCK. WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALBv2 with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.network: Security group: inbound only from ALB security group on port 8080
